JUSTIFICATION:  
You exactly match the paper’s analytical constants (C1) and analytical lower bounds (C2). The main 1D Dirichlet numerical minimal-time experiment (C3) agrees within 0.14%, and the control activation time (C4) within 0.11%; the reverse transfer case with bounded controls (C3b) matches within 1.5% with an explained discretization difference. The qualitative nonnegativity implication noted in Remark 4 is also confirmed numerically. However, several major components (multi-D theorems, Neumann boundary control numerics, and the singular Radon-measure limit as \(M\to\infty\)) were not tested, so the replication is not comprehensive.
